infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: We need your location to track mileage while driving for accurate IRS deduction calculations.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Background location access is required to accurately track mileage during your driving trips, even when the app is minimized. This ensures complete trip recording for tax deductions.
infoPlist.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Access to documents is needed to import bank statement CSV files for transaction tracking.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use your location to track driving mileage for tax deductions.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to track mileage in the background during your driving trips.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use your location to track driving mileage.
